title: Coefficient-norm bounds for evaluation on, and pull-back by, an orthonormal frame
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let v = (v_0, …, v_{n−1}) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P = Euclid P and let pL : ℝ^P → ℝⁿ be a continuous linear map with (pL x)_i = ⟨v_i, x⟩ for all x ∈ ℝ^P and i ∈ Fin n. Then (a) |β(v_0, …, v_{n−1})| ≤ |β| for every n-covector β on ℝ^P, and (b) for every l ∈ ℕ and every l-covector γ on ℝⁿ, the pulled-back covector γ∘pL (i.e. γ.compContinuousLinearMap pL, (γ∘pL)(u_1, …, u_l) = γ(pL u_1, …, pL u_l)) satisfies |γ∘pL| ≤ |γ|. Here |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm on Covector (Euclid P) _ resp. Covector (Euclid n) _.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Euclid P) (pL : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid n), Orthonormal ℝ v → (∀ (x : Euclid P) (i : Fin n), pL x i = inner ℝ (v i) x) → (∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, |β v| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ ∀ (l : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Euclid n) l), covectorEuclideanNorm (γ.compContinuousLinearMap pL) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm γ
